Full summary: Field memo fact-checked and corrected: code lens found zero errors; field-vantage lens caught 6 (three silently-dropped commitments now in the follow-ups list, our-store edge count unhitched, sibling full-surface caveat, descope ownership). Committing.
Decisions: Chose to disclose the three unshipped commitments (per-decision supersedes, D13 ask-2 neighbors reduced form, record-time diff capture) in the memo's follow-ups list rather than shipping them pre-send or staying silent — the field's culture treats silently-dropped commitments as defects; the memo now states 'none silently dropped' and earns it
Findings: The two-lens fact-check split exactly as designed: the code lens verified every version/field/semantic claim clean, while ONLY the field-vantage lens (reading the promise trail in the response doc + addendum) caught the dropped commitments and the our-store-number leak — fact-checking a cross-repo memo requires the recipient's ledger, not just the sender's code
